messages:
Rita: Quick sync  Im queuing X + LinkedIn for the benchmark webinar. Need final copy and 2 visuals by EOD. Who can pick this up?
Ned: Ill do copy. Two short variants for testing. Posting cadence idea: X thread 08:30 PT, LinkedIn long-form 10:30 PT, reminder 24h later.
Kai: I can produce hero + one stat card. Drop brand assets in the marketing drive and Ill export. ETA 3pm PT.
Rita: Routing: add utm_campaign=bench_social_sep -> form hidden `campaign=bench_sep_social`. Ops, can you map to queue `bench_webinar`?
ops: Will add mapping. Use UTM suggestion `utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=bench_sep_social`. Confirmed will route to bench_webinar owner pool.
legal-team: Please include baseline for the "3x" claim in the landing copy. Send the benchmark methodology link for review.
Ned: Draft copy (short): "New benchmark: optimized serving lowers per-token cost by up to 3x vs default configs. Watch our webinar for setups and results. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
Rita: Good. Legal acknowledge? Add reaction once cleared. Also include ISO times for scheduler. Example command:
`queue-post --chan x --time "2025-09-15T15:30:00Z" --text copy_x.txt --media hero.png --utm bench_sep_social`
Kai: Assets uploaded to drive: hero_final.png, stat_card_v1.png, alt_texts.md.
legal-team: Reviewed  Please add the comparison baseline phrase to the landing page: "compared to default open-source serving configs". Then good to publish.
Rita: Updated landing note added. Locking times now. Growth: plan to reply to top comments in first 3 hours and pin the stat tweet.
Ned: Final copy updated and pushed to scheduler. Posting window locked.
Rita: Thanks all  will post final confirmation when live."
